heading: About & Contact
bio:
Hi, I'm Your Name, a photographer based in Your City. I've spent the last several years photographing landscapes, interiors, portraits, and weddings, chasing good light wherever it leads.

I keep my approach calm and unposed so the photos feel like you. Whether it's your wedding day, a new space, or a print for your wall, I'd love to hear what you have in mind.
thanksMessage: Thank you for reaching out! I'll get back to you within two business days.
